english.title: Aircraft captain / tug driver fail to stop after aircraft accident at Bristol Airport
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..), being the

(A)_[captain of an aircraft, namely **(..SPECIFY AIRCRAFT..),]_
(B)_[tug driver of a towed Aircraft, namely **(..SPECIFY AIRCRAFT..),]_

who was present at the time the aircraft was involved in an accident at Bristol Airport, namely **(..SPECIFY LOCATION..), failed to stop and give your name and address, the name and address of the Operator at the time of the accident, the identification marks of the Aircraft and details of the accident to a Constable or Airport Official or any other person having reasonable grounds for requiring them, as soon as reasonably practicable but in any event, no later than 2 hours after the accident
english.legislation: Contrary to byelaws 8.2 and 3.4 of the Bristol Airport Byelaws 2012 and sections 63 and 64 of the Airports Act 1986.
